title: Spectacular
text: Barcelona, located in the majestic Palau Nacional on Montjuïc Hill. This museum is a real gem for art lovers, with a collection ranging from Romanesque to Catalan Modernism, offering a unique journey through the artistic history of Catalonia and beyond. The museum was founded in 1934, but the current configuration dates back to 1990, when several collections were merged to create a complete exhibition space.
